newsitem.title: INDIA: INDIA IDBI Q1 97/98 NET 3.27 BLN RUPEES.
newsitem.headline: INDIA IDBI Q1 97/98 NET 3.27 BLN RUPEES.

text.p: The Industrial Development Bank of India (IDBI) said on Wednesday its first quarter 1997/98 (April-June) net profit was 3.27 billion rupees against 2.37 billion in the first quarter last year.
Operating income during the first quarter grew 19 percent while growth in operating expenditure was 12.5 percent, an IDBI spokeswoman said.

IDBI booked only 20 million rupees in capital gains in the first quarter compared to 100 million in the previous year. The provision for taxation is higher at 1.17 billion rupees against 870 million last year, she said.
The bank, India's leading term-lending institution, attributed the higher profitability to reduction in costs.
